title: 第六十一章陷阱第六十章房里有人
slug: 扫地八十年从宗门杂役飞升成仙
lines: 叶凡看着那三个人。那三个人也看着叶凡。
魁梧弟子喊完之后，屋子里安静了一瞬。
紧接着，外面就传来了动静。
“快！把这里包围起来！一只苍蝇也不准放出去！”
这是马得水的声音。
伴随着这道声音，密集的脚步声从四面八方涌过来。
火把的光亮瞬间驱散了废阁周围的黑暗。
原本死寂的后山，一下子变得人声鼎沸。
叶凡站在门槛内，目光越过那三个外门弟子，看向门外。
几十个外门弟子举着火把，将这座破败的木屋围得水泄不通。
人群正前方，马得水倒背着双手，迈着八字步，满脸严肃地走了过来。
叶凡看着这阵仗，眼神彻底冷了下来。
他原本按在腰间短剑上的右手，缓缓松开，自然地垂落在身侧。
太巧了。
巧合到了荒谬的地步。
废阁地处后山最偏僻的角落，周围全是毒瘴，平时连个鬼影子都没有。
这三个弟子前脚刚在屋里扯着嗓子喊搜出魔道禁物，马得水后脚就带着几十号人“恰好”赶到。
这中间连半盏茶的功夫都没有。
叶凡脑海中迅速闪过整件事情的脉络。
有人潜入他的房间，破坏了他留下的记号。
然后这三个人明目张胆地进来打砸搜查。
等他回来，一脚踹开门，这三人立刻大喊大叫。
紧接着，马得水带着大批人马登场。
栽赃、喊嚷、围观、管事到场。
一环扣一环，滴水不漏。
这是一个精心布置的死局。
叶凡的面色阴沉到了极点。
他体内的灵气因为愤怒而隐隐躁动，四转锻体的强悍力量在经脉中奔涌，随时可以爆发。
但他强迫自己冷静下来。
不能动手。
现在整个天剑宗都在彻查魔道奸细，上面下了死命令，宁可错杀绝不放过。执法堂的人就在内门盯着。
content_en:
Ye Fan looked at the three people. The three people also looked at Mark.
After the burly disciple finished shouting, the room was quiet for a moment.
Immediately afterwards, there was movement outside.
"Quick! Surround this place! Don't let a fly out!"
This is the sound of horse getting water.
Along with this sound, dense footsteps came from all directions.
The light of the torch instantly dispelled the darkness around the abandoned pavilion.
The originally silent back hill suddenly became bustling with people.
Ye Fan stood inside the threshold, looking past the three outer disciples and looking out the door.
Dozens of outer disciples held torches and surrounded the dilapidated wooden house.
Right in front of the crowd, Ma Deshui walked over with his hands behind his back and a serious look on his face.
Ye Fan looked at the battle and his eyes turned completely cold.
His right hand, which was originally pressed on the dagger at his waist, slowly let go and fell naturally to his side.
What a coincidence.
Coincidence to the point of absurdity.
Feige is located in the most remote corner of the back mountain. It is surrounded by poisonous miasma and usually there is not even a trace of ghosts.
Just as these three disciples were shouting at the top of their lungs that they had found the forbidden magic objects in the room, Ma Deshui arrived with dozens of people "just in time".
There was not even enough time for half a cup of tea.
The whole context of the matter quickly flashed through Ye Fan's mind.
Someone sneaked into his room and destroyed the mark he left.
Then these three men came in brazenly to smash and search.
When he came back and kicked the door open, the three people immediately shouted.
Immediately afterwards, Ma Deshui came on stage with a large number of people.
Fraud, shouting, onlookers, and stewards were present.
One link after another, no leakage.
This is a carefully staged dead end.
Ye Fan's expression was extremely gloomy.
The spiritual energy in his body was faintly restless due to anger, and the powerful power of the fourth-turn body training surged through his meridians and could explode at any time.
But he forced himself to calm down.
Can't do anything.
Now the entire Tianjian Sect is thoroughly investigating the demon spies, and the superiors have issued death orders, and would rather kill them by mistake than let them go. The people from the Law Enforcement Hall were watching from the inner door.
